description: This Dart source file defines a LoginScreen widget for a Flutter application, implementing a user login interface with form validation, state management, and navigation upon successful login. It interacts with external providers and routing modules.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the login screen, providing user interface for email/password login with validation and navigation.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: The state class managing the login form, input controllers, loading state, form validation, and error handling.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the TextEditingController objects when the widget is removed from the widget tree.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Validates the form and attempts to perform login via AuthProvider. Navigates to home on success or shows error message on failure.

methods.description: Displays a SnackBar with an error message.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the login form UI, including input fields, buttons, and error handling.
